name: Point-based Differentiable Rendering
definition: A rendering method that models a 3D scene as a learnable point cloud (collection of parameterized points) and uses a differentiable rendering pipeline to optimize point attributes via gradient descent.
summary: Point-based Differentiable Rendering optimizes a learnable point cloud of parameterized ellipsoids via gradient descent to reconstruct 3D scenes from 2D images, distinguishing itself by using ellipsoids rather than spheres for efficient splat rendering.
